title: The Income-tax Act, 2025: what changed on 1 April 2026
author: CA Sagar H R
summary: The new Act replaced the 1961 Act on 1 April 2026. Which Act applies to which year, the single tax year, and what has and has not changed.

title: TDS and TCS under the Income-tax Act, 2025
author: CA Sagar H R
summary: Where the TDS and TCS provisions now sit, the current thresholds, the new forms and payment codes, and the TCS changes from 1 April 2026.

title: Presumptive taxation under section 58 of the Income-tax Act, 2025
author: CA Sagar H R
summary: Sections 44AD, 44ADA and 44AE are now one section, 58. Who can use it, the limits and rates, and a change in wording on deductions.

title: Updated returns: the four-year window and what it costs
author: CA Sagar H R
summary: An updated return can be filed up to four years late, at an additional tax of 25% to 70%. When it can be used, and the changes from 1 March 2026.

title: Tax on selling property: 12.5%, or 20% with indexation for residents
author: CA Sagar H R
summary: Long-term gains on land and buildings are taxed at 12.5% without indexation. For residents selling older property, tax is capped at 20% with indexation.
